title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
requirement: Makes it unlawful under the New Jersey Antitrust Act for a rental property owner to subscribe to or use a coordinator's algorithmic pricing services, and for any person to perform a coordinating function or engage in parallel pricing coordination.
coverage_conditions: All rental residential dwelling units in New Jersey; "residential dwelling unit" excludes inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or correctional facilities.
exemptions: Excluded from "coordinating function": research, statistical analysis or testing; a free public estimated rent; an equal-access real estate brokerage database; and government entities setting rents through affordability controls.
penalty: A violation is a violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act and subject to its remedies and penalties under P.L.1970, c.73 sections 6 through 17.
quoted_span: It shall be unlawful and a violation of the “New Jersey Antitrust Act,” P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.) for: a. a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator;
interaction: Prohibits municipalities from enacting ordinances that conflict with this act.

relations.quote: A municipality shall be prohibited from enacting an ordinance that conflicts with this act.
